sentences.text: Intestinimonas is a bacterial genus, with strain AF211 isolated from the human intestine.
A study reported that Intestinimonas strain AF211 converts lysine into butyrate and acetate, and also converts the Amadori product fructoselysine into butyrate.
The pduCDE glycerol/diol dehydratase, which also forms propionate from 1,2-propanediol, was detected in human stool metagenomes, among taxa including Intestinimonas butyriciproducens.
In a cross-sectional study, the genus Intestinimonas was a biomarker of the overweight/obese group and was negatively associated with saturated fatty acid intake.
